title: Landscaping plan for five or more grouped dwellings
text: Landscaping plan. C1.2.8 For five or more grouped dwellings, provide a landscaping plan in accordance with Appendix A3.

replaces.note: Part C: multiple dwellings or 5+ grouped dwellings
new deemed exempt requirement for grouped R25 and below

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to Chapter 3 (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies to five or more grouped dwellings (rule condition). Whether the plan accords with Appendix A3 is stated by the applicant; its content is not tested.
